issue_request: FHIR-31762 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction raised against R4B and applied for R5. It requested fixing two typos in the CodeableReference.concept StructureDefinition definition: replacing "it's" with possessive "its" and adding the missing space in "classto".
initial_application: The correction appears to have been applied before this reconciliation. Git history includes Jira-tagged commits for FHIR-31762, and commit 8377633d6a90cf16cb54f9ea84055c3b9aa39cdd changes source/datatypes/codeablereference.xml from "it's general classto" to "its general class to". The Jira comments also record that the work was merged into the R4B pull request HL7/fhir#1733 and the R5 pull request HL7/fhir#1731.
additional_context: CodeableReference is an active datatype in source/fhir.ini, has an active type page mapping, and is marked normative, so source/datatypes/codeablereference.xml is in current build scope. Current source line 882 already contains the corrected wording. Searches for the misspellings in the current datatype source found no remaining occurrence, and Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no related decision that changes the correction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active source already satisfies the Published Jira request.
